# GitHub token connect

## What to build

Add GitHub (github.com and GitHub Enterprise Server) as the second code host, connected with a **pasted personal access token** (fine-grained or classic). There is no GitHub App, manifest flow, JWT or installation token in v1 — that was explicitly decided. This slice adds a `GithubCodeHostProvider` implementing the existing `CodeHostProvider` contract, a GitHub flavor in the existing `CodeHostEmulator`, a `codeHosts.github.connectToken` oRPC procedure, and runs the GitHub adapter through the existing shared conformance suite. After this slice `codeHosts/connections/list`, `codeHosts/repositories/list` and `codeHosts/connections/remove` (already implemented generically) work for GitHub connections too.

Already in the codebase (from the foundation slice): `packages/adapter-kit/src/code-host.ts` (`CodeHostProvider`, `CodeHostConnectionRef`, `CodeHostIdentity`, `CodeHostRepository`, `VerifiedCodeHostCredential`, `GitCredential`, `CodeHostRequestRejected` with reasons `invalid_url | unauthorized | missing_scopes | excess_scopes | not_found | unreachable`, `CodeHostRetryLater`); `packages/adapters/src/gitlab-code-host.ts` (reference implementation); `packages/adapters/src/code-host-emulator.ts` (`CodeHostEmulator(flavor)`, real HTTP server, `addToken`, `addProject`, `requests`, `failNext`, `handleGithub` stub); `packages/adapters/src/code-host-factory.ts` (`createCodeHostProviders` with `github: undefined`); `packages/adapters/src/code-host-conformance.test.ts` (harness map with `gitlab`); `apps/api/src/routes/code-hosts.ts` (`codeHostsRoutes` with `gitlab.connectToken`); `packages/contracts/src/code-host.ts` (`CodeHostTokenInputSchema`, `CodeHostConnectionSchema`) and the `codeHosts` block in `packages/contracts/src/rpc.ts`.

## Context: files to read before implementing

- `CODE-HOST-INTEGRATION-PRD.md` sections 9 ("GitHub token checks", "Commit authorship") and 10 ("Connect GitHub").
- `packages/adapter-kit/src/code-host.ts` — contract to implement.
- `packages/adapters/src/gitlab-code-host.ts` — mirror its structure, base URL normalization, timeouts, error mapping.
- `packages/adapters/src/code-host-emulator.ts` — add the GitHub flavor in `handleGithub`.
- `packages/adapters/src/code-host-conformance.test.ts` — add a `github` harness.
- `apps/api/src/routes/code-hosts.ts` — the `gitlab.connectToken` handler to generalize.
- `apps/api/src/security-audit.ts` — `AUDITED_PROCEDURES` entry for `codeHosts.gitlab.connectToken` to duplicate for GitHub.
- `apps/api/src/router-code-hosts.test.ts` — extend with GitHub cases.

## Patterns to follow

**API base for a web base URL:**
```ts
// github.com web → api.github.com; GHES https://ghe.example.com → https://ghe.example.com/api/v3
function apiBase(baseUrl: string) {
  const url = new URL(baseUrl);
  return url.hostname === "github.com" ? "https://api.github.com" : `${url.origin}${url.pathname.replace(/\/$/, "")}/api/v3`;
}
```
**Headers:** `Authorization: Bearer <token>`, `Accept: application/vnd.github+json`, `X-GitHub-Api-Version: 2022-11-28`, `User-Agent: rakazo`.

**Error handling:** same mapping as the GitLab adapter: 401 → `unauthorized`; 404 → `not_found`; 403 with `x-ratelimit-remaining: 0` or 429 → `CodeHostRetryLater("rate_limited", retryAfterMs)`; 5xx → `CodeHostRetryLater("unavailable")`; fetch throws → `unreachable`. Never include the token in messages.

## Step-by-step tasks

### CREATE `packages/adapters/src/github-code-host.ts`
- **IMPLEMENT** `export class GithubCodeHostProvider implements CodeHostProvider` (`provider = "github"`, `constructor(private readonly options: { fetch?: typeof fetch } = {})`):
  - Base URL normalization: default `https://github.com`; same rules as GitLab (no credentials/query/hash, trailing slash stripped).
  - `connectToken`: `GET {api}/user`.
    - 401 → `unauthorized`.
    - Read `x-oauth-scopes` header. **Present (classic token):** split on `,`/trim; require `repo` or `public_repo` else `missing_scopes(["repo"])`; refuse if it contains `workflow`, `delete_repo`, or any scope starting with `admin:` → `CodeHostRequestRejected("excess_scopes", [those scopes])`. **Absent (fine-grained token):** accept; `scopes = []`.
    - Identity: `{ hostUserId: String(id), username: login, displayName: name ?? login, isBotUser: false, noreplyEmail: \`${id}+${login}@users.noreply.${host}\` }` where `host` is `github.com` for github.com, else the GHES hostname. `label = login`.
  - `listRepositories(conn, query)`: `GET {api}/user/repos?per_page=100&sort=updated&affiliation=owner,collaborator,organization_member` (follow `Link: rel="next"` up to 5 pages); keep repos with `permissions.push === true`; filter by `query` case-insensitively on `full_name`; map `{ hostRepoId: String(id), fullPath: full_name, defaultBranch: default_branch }`.
  - `getRepository(conn, hostRepoId)`: `GET {api}/repositories/{id}`; 404 → `not_found`.
  - `gitCredential`: `{ username: "x-access-token", password: secret.token }`.
  - `remoteUrl`: `${webBase}/${fullPath}.git` (webBase is the normalized base URL, e.g. `https://github.com`).
  - Requests use `redirect: "manual"` and a 15 s timeout combined with the caller's signal.
- **GOTCHA**: fine-grained tokens have no scopes header; don't treat that as an error. The `excess_scopes` refusal is what keeps a classic token from changing `.github/workflows` — keep it.
- **VALIDATE**: `pnpm --filter @rakazo/adapters check`

### UPDATE `packages/adapters/src/code-host-emulator.ts`
- **IMPLEMENT** GitHub flavor in `handleGithub`. The emulator serves the API under **`/api/v3`** (as GHES does), so tests use `emulator.baseUrl` as a GHES base URL:
  - Auth: `Authorization: Bearer|token <token>`; unknown → 401 `{ message: "Bad credentials" }`.
  - `GET /api/v3/user` → `{ id, login, name }`; set `x-oauth-scopes: <scopes joined ", ">` only when the token was added with `classic: true` (extend `addToken` options with `classic?: boolean`).
  - `GET /api/v3/user/repos` → `[{ id: Number, full_name, default_branch, permissions: { push: true } }]` for member projects; supports `per_page`/`page` and emits a `Link` header when more pages exist.
  - `GET /api/v3/repositories/:id` → same shape or 404 `{ message: "Not Found" }`.
- **GOTCHA**: `addProject` ids must be numeric strings for GitHub (`String(n)`).

### UPDATE `packages/adapters/src/code-host-factory.ts` and `packages/adapters/src/index.ts`
- **IMPLEMENT**: `github: new GithubCodeHostProvider(options)`; export the new file from the barrel.

### UPDATE `packages/contracts/src/rpc.ts`
- **IMPLEMENT**: in `codeHosts`, add `github: { connectToken: oc.input(CodeHostTokenInputSchema).output(CodeHostConnectionSchema) }` (additive; don't touch other entries).

### UPDATE `apps/api/src/routes/code-hosts.ts`
- **IMPLEMENT**: extract the body of `gitlab.connectToken` into a local `connectWithToken(kind: CodeHostKind, context, input)` and use it for both `gitlab.connectToken` and the new `github.connectToken`. Map `excess_scopes` exactly like `missing_scopes` but with `data: { error: "excess_scopes", excess: detail }`.
- **UPDATE** `apps/api/src/security-audit.ts`: add `"codeHosts.github.connectToken": { type: "credential.created", kind: "code_host" }`.

### UPDATE `packages/adapters/src/code-host-conformance.test.ts`
- **IMPLEMENT**: add a `github` harness (`new CodeHostEmulator("github")`, provider `new GithubCodeHostProvider()`; base URL = `emulator.baseUrl`). All existing shared cases must pass for both. Add GitHub-only cases: classic token with `workflow` → `excess_scopes` listing `workflow`; classic token with only `read:user` → `missing_scopes(["repo"])`; fine-grained (no header) accepted; pagination across 2 pages.
- **VALIDATE**: `pnpm vitest run packages/adapters/src/code-host-conformance.test.ts`

### UPDATE `apps/api/src/router-code-hosts.test.ts`
- **IMPLEMENT**: `codeHosts/github/connectToken` happy path (row `provider: "github"`, label = login), excess scopes → error data `{ error: "excess_scopes", excess: ["workflow"] }`, and `repositories/list` for the GitHub connection.

## Acceptance criteria

- [ ] `POST /rpc/codeHosts/github/connectToken` `{ json: { baseUrl, token } }` creates a `provider: "github"` connection with `label` = GitHub login.
- [ ] Classic tokens need `repo`/`public_repo` and are refused when they carry `workflow`, `delete_repo` or `admin:*`; fine-grained tokens are accepted.
- [ ] github.com uses `https://api.github.com`; any other base URL uses `<base>/api/v3`.
- [ ] Repository listing only includes repositories with push permission.
- [ ] The conformance suite runs every shared case against both GitLab and GitHub.
- [ ] No token appears in errors/logs (asserted).
- [ ] Tests pass: `pnpm vitest run packages/adapters/src/code-host-conformance.test.ts apps/api/src/router-code-hosts.test.ts`

## Validation commands

```bash
pnpm lint && pnpm check
pnpm vitest run packages/adapters/src/code-host-conformance.test.ts apps/api/src/router-code-hosts.test.ts
```
